newsitem.title: UK: Survey shows Citibank, JP morgan as best FX banks.
newsitem.headline: Survey shows Citibank, JP morgan as best FX banks.

text.p: Fund managers have voted Citibank as the best provider of overall foreign exchange services offered by banks and JP Morgan as their research favourite, a survey by Global Investor magazine showed.

"Global Investor magazine has published the results of its annual survey of fund mangers' views of the foreign exchange services offered by banks. Citibank has emerged as the overall provider of choice, though JP Morgan has an edge in research," the magazine said in a release on Thursday.
The annual survey, compiled from responses to more than 350 fund managers worldwide, showed Citibank, Chase Manhattan and JP Morgan as the banks providing the best overall FX service.
Fund managers also voted SBC Warburg as the bank having the best options/volatility research and the best options trading strategy advice.

"The survey found that the key criteria for selecting an FX counterparty are price, quote speed, credit standing, efficiency of back office, breadth of coverage, liquidity, research strategy and trading recommendations.
